guard: four shipped entry admission guards refuse before any acquisition tool or engine runs
why: Four runtime child controls require each designated guard message, not just a nonzero exit. Removing one guard reaches a later refusal with a different message and must redden its named control. No mutant admits the full acquisition path: later guards remain and each control supplies incomplete hosted context.

Three structural checks remain distinct from four runtime controls. Workflow jobs, event inputs, exact gates and artifact paths use the existing root yaml parser, not string includes or commented text.

Each mutation restores exact source through the maintained tool and then reruns the same full seven-control command. No build outputs are generated, no package install or engine imports. The completion marker is stock TAP total printed on pass and fail, not a success-only banner.

Own baseline, four designated kills and full restored controls are required before separately admitted manual acquisition. Source-only author has run none of these. Tests do not prove valid acquisition, full tool/config/privacy custody or returned dependency graph.
